conf.description: Ivanti ICS user-access JSON filter: deserializes the native JSON export; ECS/custom field mapping is NOT implemented because Ivanti publishes no key names for this filter (see README gap) and guessing them risks silently wrong data.

conf.comment: Ivanti ICS user-access, JSON filter. Key names are unpublished (Datadog confirms only the record classes covered, not field names) - per brief, an unguessable field name is left unmapped rather than guessed. This pipeline deserializes JSON and tags event.dataset only; full ECS mapping needs a captured sample from the target firmware. See ivanti-ics/README.md gaps.

functions.description: record the field-name gap up front
deserialize the JSON record so its native keys become individually queryable, even though they are not yet renamed to ECS
tag the dataset; no other field is safe to map without a firmware capture
